## load packages and data

```{r message=F}
rm(list = ls())

library(psych) # v.2.4.6.26
library(here) # v.1.0.1
library(dplyr) # v.1.2.1
library(ggplot2) # v.4.0.2
library(ggpubr) # v.0.6.0
library(tidyr) # v.1.3.1
library(see) # v.0.12.0

df_commMeasures_somatomotor_raw <- 
  read.csv(here("Analysis_data", "coupling_comm_measures_somatomotor.csv"), sep=",")

df_commMeasures_somatomotor_rawfunc_raw <- 
  read.csv(here("Analysis_data", "rawfunc_coupling_comm_measures_somatomotor.csv"), sep=",")

df_BIS <- 
  read.csv(here("Data", "BIS_Complete_processed.csv"), sep = ";")

load(here("Data", "APM.RData"))

df_CD_raw <-
  read.csv(here("Analysis_data", "G04_CD_in_timewindows_4subs_removed.csv"), sep = ",")

```

## prepare dataset

```{r}
data_outlier <- dataACC
data_outlier$PropCorrOdd <- NA
data_outlier$PropCorrEven <- NA

data_outlier <- data_outlier %>% group_by(Subject) %>% 
  mutate(PropCorr = mean(Accuracy))
data_outlier <- data_outlier %>% group_by(Subject) %>% 
  mutate(PropCorrOdd = mean(Accuracy[Odd_Even == 1]))
data_outlier <- data_outlier %>% group_by(Subject) %>% 
  mutate(PropCorrEven = mean(Accuracy[Odd_Even == 2]))
data_outlier <- data_outlier%>% filter(RTms >= 150) 

dataACC <- data_outlier #dataACC = column with percentage correct and only trials with RT > 150 ms

APM <- as.matrix(dataACC[,c("Subject", "PropCorrOdd", "PropCorrEven", "PropCorr")])
APM <- unique(APM)

df_intelligence <- merge(df_BIS, APM, by = "Subject", all = TRUE)
df_intelligence$numcorrect <- 36*df_intelligence$PropCorr

# remove invalid participants
df_intelligence <- df_intelligence[-c(216, 217, 218, 219, 220, 221, 222),]
df_intelligence <- df_intelligence[, c("Subject", "PC_Mean", "PS_Mean", "M_Mean", "C_Mean", "g_Mean", "PropCorrOdd", "PropCorrEven")]

df_intelligence$PC_Mean <- as.numeric(scale(df_intelligence$PC_Mean)) 
df_intelligence$PS_Mean <- as.numeric(scale(df_intelligence$PS_Mean))
df_intelligence$M_Mean <- as.numeric(scale(df_intelligence$M_Mean))
df_intelligence$C_Mean <- as.numeric(scale(df_intelligence$C_Mean))
df_intelligence$PropCorrOdd <- as.numeric(scale(df_intelligence$PropCorrOdd))
df_intelligence$PropCorrEven <- as.numeric(scale(df_intelligence$PropCorrEven))
```

## clean data
```{r}
# communication measures somatomotor
df_commMeasures_somatomotor = df_commMeasures_somatomotor_raw
initial_NA_count <- sum(is.na(df_commMeasures_somatomotor))

for (x in 2:ncol(df_commMeasures_somatomotor)) {
  sample_mean = mean(df_commMeasures_somatomotor[,x], na.rm = TRUE)
  sample_SD = sd(df_commMeasures_somatomotor[,x], na.rm = TRUE)
  df_commMeasures_somatomotor[,x][df_commMeasures_somatomotor[,x] >
                        sample_mean+3*sample_SD] <- NA
  df_commMeasures_somatomotor[,x][df_commMeasures_somatomotor[,x] <
                        sample_mean-3*sample_SD] <- NA

}

final_NA_count <- sum(is.na(df_commMeasures_somatomotor))
num_NAs_generated_commMeasures_v <- final_NA_count - initial_NA_count
percentage_Exclusion_commMeasures_v <- num_NAs_generated_commMeasures_v/(nrow(df_commMeasures_somatomotor)*5)

# communication measures rawfunc somatomotor
df_commMeasures_somatomotor_rawfunc = df_commMeasures_somatomotor_rawfunc_raw
initial_NA_count <- sum(is.na(df_commMeasures_somatomotor_rawfunc))

for (x in 2:ncol(df_commMeasures_somatomotor_rawfunc)) {
  sample_mean = mean(df_commMeasures_somatomotor_rawfunc[,x], na.rm = TRUE)
  sample_SD = sd(df_commMeasures_somatomotor_rawfunc[,x], na.rm = TRUE)
  df_commMeasures_somatomotor_rawfunc[,x][df_commMeasures_somatomotor_rawfunc[,x] >
                        sample_mean+3*sample_SD] <- NA
  df_commMeasures_somatomotor_rawfunc[,x][df_commMeasures_somatomotor_rawfunc[,x] <
                        sample_mean-3*sample_SD] <- NA

}

final_NA_count <- sum(is.na(df_commMeasures_somatomotor_rawfunc))
num_NAs_generated_commMeasures_v_rawfunc <- final_NA_count - initial_NA_count
percentage_Exclusion_commMeasures_v_rawfunc <- num_NAs_generated_commMeasures_v_rawfunc/(nrow(df_commMeasures_somatomotor_rawfunc)*5)

# CD values
df_CD = df_CD_raw[,c(1,6:13)]

initial_NA_count <- sum(is.na(df_CD))

for (x in 2:ncol(df_CD)) {
  sample_mean = mean(df_CD[,x], na.rm = TRUE)
  sample_SD = sd(df_CD[,x], na.rm = TRUE)
  df_CD[,x][df_CD[,x] >
                        sample_mean+3*sample_SD] <- NA
  df_CD[,x][df_CD[,x] <
                        sample_mean-3*sample_SD] <- NA

}

final_NA_count <- sum(is.na(df_CD))
num_NAs_generated_CD <- final_NA_count - initial_NA_count
percentage_Exclusion_CD <- num_NAs_generated_CD/(nrow(df_CD)*8)


```



## plot communication measures and get means and SDs

```{r}
## residualized timeseries
# somatomotor
colnames(df_commMeasures_somatomotor) <- c("Subject", "DE", "–SI", 
                               "PT", "RE", "C")
df_commMeasures_somatomotor_long <- pivot_longer(df_commMeasures_somatomotor, cols = c(2:6))
colnames(df_commMeasures_somatomotor_long) <- c("Subject", "Measure", "Value")

summary_df_somatomotor <- df_commMeasures_somatomotor_long %>%
  group_by(Measure) %>%
  summarise(mean_val = round(mean(Value, na.rm = T),2),
            sd_val = round(sd(Value, na.rm = T),2))


## rawfunc timeseries somatomotor
colnames(df_commMeasures_somatomotor_rawfunc) <- c("Subject", "DE", "–SI", 
                               "PT", "RE", "C")
df_commMeasures_somatomotor_rawfunc_long <- pivot_longer(df_commMeasures_somatomotor_rawfunc, cols = c(2:6))
colnames(df_commMeasures_somatomotor_rawfunc_long) <- c("Subject", "Measure", "Value")

summary_df_somatomotor_rawfunc <- df_commMeasures_somatomotor_rawfunc_long %>%
  group_by(Measure) %>%
  summarise(mean_val = round(mean(Value, na.rm = T),2),
            sd_val = round(sd(Value, na.rm = T),2))



```


## combine data

```{r}
df_commMeasures_somatomotor[, 2:6] <- scale(df_commMeasures_somatomotor[, 2:6])
df_commMeasures_somatomotor_rawfunc[, 2:6] <- scale(df_commMeasures_somatomotor_rawfunc[, 2:6])
df_CD[, 2:9] <- scale(df_CD[, 2:9])

df_commMeasures_somatomotor$Subject <- as.numeric(sub("sub-", "", df_commMeasures_somatomotor$Subject))
df_commMeasures_somatomotor_rawfunc$Subject <- as.numeric(sub("sub-", "", df_commMeasures_somatomotor_rawfunc$Subject))

df_somatomotor <- df_commMeasures_somatomotor %>%
  select(Subject, DE, "–SI", PT, RE, C) %>%
  full_join(
    df_intelligence %>% 
      select(Subject, PC_Mean, PS_Mean, C_Mean, M_Mean, g_Mean, PropCorrOdd, PropCorrEven),
    by = "Subject"
  )

df_somatomotor_rawfunc <- df_commMeasures_somatomotor_rawfunc %>%
  select(Subject, DE, "–SI", PT, RE, C) %>%
  full_join(
    df_intelligence %>% 
      select(Subject, PC_Mean, PS_Mean, C_Mean, M_Mean, g_Mean, PropCorrOdd, PropCorrEven),
    by = "Subject"
  )

df_CD$ERPset_new <- sub("switching_sub-", "", df_CD$ERPset)
df_CD$Subject <- as.numeric(sub("_bin_average", "", df_CD$ERPset_new))

df_somatomotor <- df_CD %>%
  select(Subject, E_CD_OE_R, E_CD_OE_S, E_CD_LM_R, E_CD_LM_S, 
         L_CD_OE_R, L_CD_OE_S, L_CD_LM_R, L_CD_LM_S) %>%
  full_join(df_somatomotor, by = "Subject"
  )

df_somatomotor_rawfunc <- df_CD %>%
  select(Subject, E_CD_OE_R, E_CD_OE_S, E_CD_LM_R, E_CD_LM_S, 
         L_CD_OE_R, L_CD_OE_S, L_CD_LM_R, L_CD_LM_S) %>%
  full_join(df_somatomotor_rawfunc, by = "Subject"
  )

```
